architecture_summary: Project-owned CNN width tokenizer with a compact Transformer encoder and ordered fixed character/type slots.
intended_use: Recognition of a detected Turkish plate crop followed by structural validation and human review.
limitations: Development-validation metrics are not production accuracy.
Structural validity does not prove transcription correctness.
project_provenance: Project-developed and project-trained PyTorch implementation selected after controlled comparison of four project recognition families.

citations.reference: Schuster and Paliwal, Bidirectional Recurrent Neural Networks, IEEE Transactions on Signal Processing, 1997
Graves et al., Connectionist Temporal Classification, ICML 2006
